name: ZCA_ES_ATTRIBUTES
description: This table is used to store the attributes of an entity

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the primary key for the attribute within the meta-data version

columns.name: META_MODEL_VERSION_UUID
columns.description: the meta-data version for this attribute

columns.name: ENTITY_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the entity that this attribute belongs to

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: the language-independent name for the entity composed from alphanumberic characters, plus underscore, beginning with a letter

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: one of 'Record', 'ForeignKey', 'Boolean', 'Byte', 'Short', 'Integer', 'Long', 'Float', 'Double', 'String', 'BigDecimal', 'Date', 'Percentage', 'Time', or 'Timestamp'

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid for the attriute that holds the currency code for this attribute

columns.name: CONV_EXCH_RATE_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: stores the uuid of the attribute that holds the conversion rate for converting the currency to the corporate currency.

columns.name: ENTITY_USAGE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the entity usage that this attribute applies to, if any

columns.name: COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: the column name in the table name for the entity usage that this attribute is sourced from, if any

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: the lookup type if the attributes is an enum atrtibute otherwise null. The lookup type may either be the name of a SqlForLookupType enum or an lookup type that appears in FND_LOOKUP_TYPES

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE_EXPR
columns.description: the expression that is used to initialize the lookup type when a sandbox is created

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE_V_A_ID
columns.description: The view application id to be used for the lookup type, if any

columns.name: AGGREGATION_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: the name of the type of aggregation, either Max, Min, Sum, or Average

columns.name: AGGREGATE_CLAUSE
columns.description: the select clause to compute the aggregate from the database

columns.name: AGGREGATE_CHILD_ATTR_UUID
columns.description: the UUID of a child entity's attribute over which to compute in-document aggregations (mutually exclusive with AGGREGATE_CLAUSE)

columns.name: RECORD_ENTITY_UUID
columns.description: the foreign key for the entity that describes the record if the attribute type name is 'Record'

columns.name: USES_SECURITY_CONTEXT_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is a foreign key reference that needs to include the security context of the reign key, otherwise N

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_UUID_FOR_FILTERING
columns.description:
the uuid of the attribute within this entity that contains source of the filtering.  If the attribute is a foreign key, then the uuid points to the attribute that holds the foreign key provided the FILTER is satidfied.  If the atrtibute is a record, then
the uuid points to the attribute that contains the list of records to be filtered

columns.name: FILTERED_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the attribute to be filtered.  The attrbute type must be Long and the attribute to be filtered must match the type of this attribute and be an attribute in the recrod entity that is filtered.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_UUID_FOR_RECORDS
columns.description: Obsolete: Replaced by ATTRIBUTE_UUID_FOR_FILTERING

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_FILTER
columns.description: the json string for the map that holds the value constrains for establishing the forign key or record.The REFRESH_ATTRIBUTE_UUID holds attribute that triggers recomputation and ATTRIBUTE_UUID_FOR_FILTERING

columns.name: RECORDS_FILTER
columns.description: Obsolete: Replaced by ATTRIBUTE_FILTER

columns.name: SQL_FOR_VALUE_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: the name of the SqlForValueType enum used to compute the attribute value

columns.name: SQL_BIND_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the attribute that serves as the bind variable in SQL_FOR_ATTRIUTE_VALUE

columns.name: REFRESH_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the attribute that should cause the value for this attribute to be re-computed

columns.name: SQL_REFRESH_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: Obsolete: Replaced by REFRESH_ATTRIBUTE_UUID

columns.name: REFRESH_DOC_FIELD_PATH
columns.description: Obsolete

columns.name: SQL_REFRESH_DOC_FIELD_PATH
columns.description: Obsolete: Replaced by REFRESH_DOC_FIELD_PATH

columns.name: SQL_HIERARCHY_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: the name of the hierarchy that this attribute is dependent on, if any

columns.name: MIN_OCCURS
columns.description: the minimum times the attribute occurs

columns.name: MAX_OCCURS
columns.description: the maximum times the attribute occurs

columns.name: SECURITY_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the security type, either Secured, Unsecured, or Mixed

columns.name: SECURED_DATA_TYPE_NAMES
columns.description: If the attibuteis not secured, then the value is NULL. If the attribute is secured and the attribute belongs to a top-level entity then the value is a serialized JSON string that represents the list of secured data type names that need to be checked for access

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is an identifier

columns.name: LOCALIZABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Y if the attribute is localizable,e.g., it is sourced from TL table.

columns.name: COPY_TO_ENTITY_ALL_FIELD_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the values for this attribute sghould be copied to the entity's _all field, otherwise N

columns.name: INCLUDE_IN_REFERENCE_FLAG
columns.description: Y if the field should be included in the reference.  Child entities must have all their attributes marked as Y.

columns.name: INLINE_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute refers to a foreign key (or record) whose fields should be 'promoted' to same level as this attribute

columns.name: SEARCHABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is searchable

columns.name: SORTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is sortable

columns.name: AGGREGATABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute can be used for aggregation

columns.name: DEFAULT_AGGREGATION_UUID
columns.description: Obsolete: the uuid of the default aggregation for this field, if any

columns.name: TRANSIENT_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is transient, e.g., "Snippet" is transient, not searchable, not sortable, and not aggreggatable

columns.name: LANG_DETECT_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y to enable CJK language support for non translatable attributes

columns.name: EXTN_ATTRIBUTE_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is an extension field

columns.name: RESOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Y if the attribute is an resource field

columns.name: CAN_BE_ENABLED_DISABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute can be enabled/disabled

columns.name: FORBID_REFERENCE_FLAG
columns.description: Y if the attribute cannot be included in reference

columns.name: IN_SECURITY_CONTEXT_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is part of the security context for the attribute's entity, otherwise N

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is enabled

columns.name: INDEXED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the attribute is indexed in Elastic Search

columns.name: DISPLAY_WIDTH
columns.description: the display width for the attribute

columns.name: MIN_LENGTH
columns.description: the minimum length for the attribute

columns.name: MAX_LENGTH
columns.description: the maximum length for the attribute

columns.name: DECIMAL_PLACES
columns.description: the number of decimal places to use, iff applicable

columns.name: MIN_VALUE
columns.description: the min value, iff applicable

columns.name: MAX_VALUE
columns.description: the max value, iff applicable

columns.name: RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The resource bundle for this attribute

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_NAME
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized name

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized description

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_HELP
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized help

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The customized resource bundle for this attribute

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_KEY_NAME
columns.description: the resource key in the EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized name

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_KEY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: the resource key in the EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized description

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_KEY_HELP
columns.description: the resource key in the EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized help

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the row was deleted, otherwise N

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Y if the attribute is RecordType

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_ROLES
columns.description: Jason data for record type roles and corresponding values for roles

columns.name: ALIAS_TO_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: Current row is the alias attribute, specified UUID in this column is the real indexed attribute

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: NORMALIZER_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: One of 'Lowercase', 'Uppercase','TitleCase' or 'None'. This represents to normalizer used for indexing the attribute.

columns.name: NGRAM_ANALYZER_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: One of the Ngram Analyzer Types like TwoThruTenNgram or NumberNgram

columns.name: EDGE_ANALYZER_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: COLUMN1

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
